issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A synthetic check of one resource before a real film. It is not a film: do only this, briefly, and do not retry a failed step another way.

editor and director, each in its first turn: read `ht-resource describe image-generation`, make exactly one request as it says for a small image of a lit match in snow, save the image, check it with `file`, and write `probe.md` in your repository with the HTTP status and the file's type, or the exact error (at most 10 lines). The director then approves the release if both images were made; otherwise it says which failed.
issue.title: Film objective
